Welcome to The Shillery! In this post, I will just go over some rules I want to go over, what a shill is, and the status of shills (Suspected, Likely, and Confirmed).

Rule 1) No spam/trolling

This is pretty self-explanatory. Do not spam posts, and do not troll others.

Rules 2) Be respectful of others and their ideas

This means to not disrespect others because of their beliefs and ideas. Yes, this is a controversial sub, but no one should be disrespected because they chose to contribute to it.

Rule 3) Be intellectually honest

We will be calling people shills, but we don't do it for fun. You need to back up your ideas and beliefs with evidence, probability, etc. You can not just call someone a shill because you do not like them. Now on to the level of certainty that said person is a shill.

There are 3 categories we put shills under.

Suspected, Likely, and Confirmed.

A suspected shill is someone who seems suspicious, and where there is little evidence that they are a shill. Anyone under this category shouldn't be labeled a shill per say, but someone to keep an eye on.

A likely shill is someone who has been suspected fo a while and by many, with fair proof, they are a shill.

A confirmed shill is someone who has been suspected for a really long time and by tons of people... more well known than a likely shill. There must also be irrefutable proof they are a shill, hence the name confirmed.
